group: Metal Armor Dragonar + Martian Successor Nadesico (TV and Prince of Darkness)

entries.role: Pilot of Dragonar-1 (D-1); Earth Alliance/Federation trainee promoted to Warrant Officer; protagonist
entries.personality: Hot-blooded, impulsive, acts before thinking; chases Linda; resents his absent father
entries.notes: Dragonar wiki page title and official site (dragonar.net) agree on "Kaine Wakaba". Hepburn would be "Ken Wakaba" (ケーン); do not use.

entries.role: Pilot of Dragonar-2 (D-2, long-range artillery); Kaine's best friend
entries.personality: Cheerful, laid-back New Yorker; loyal and family-minded (sends his pay home); serious when it counts
entries.notes: CONTESTED. Wiki page title (Dragonar wiki; also Mechapedia, en.wikipedia) = "Tapp Oceano". Official site dragonar.net/character/e03.php = "Tap Oseano". Per BASE_RULES (wiki wins) keep Tapp Oceano, matching the sister project. Variants: Tap Oseano (official), Tappu Oseano (Hepburn).

entries.role: Pilot of Dragonar-3 (D-3, electronic warfare/recon); Kaine's friend
entries.personality: Cheerful, quick-witted, the level head of the trio; rebels against his British political family; bookish gourmet
entries.notes: Wiki and official site agree.

entries.role: Giganos Colonel commanding the Gon Jem Squad (the "Filth of Giganos"); pilots the Geyzam, later the prototype Gilgazamune
entries.personality: Brutal, crude, greedy and cunning, with famously bad table manners; superb pilot; fiercely loyal to his Four Kings
entries.notes: CONTESTED vs literal kana. Katakana is グン (Gun), but every wiki (Dragonar wiki section "Gon Jem Squad", Mechapedia, SRW wiki, en.wikipedia) and the official site (dragonar.net g07: "GON JEM") use "Gon Jem". Variants: Gun Jem (literal, sister-project form), Gon Gem. Game ja uses a half-width middle dot in the full name.

entries.role: Captain and top ace of the Giganos Imperial Guard armored corps ("Blue Hawk of Giganos"); Falguen pilot; framed by Dorchenov, later fights him beside Kaine
entries.personality: Noble, calm and honorable; devoted to Marshal Guiltorre; resents his father Lang for defecting
entries.notes: Wiki page title and official site (g01: "Meio Plato") agree. Fan-translation variants Mayo Plato, Maj Plato, Maillot, Maiyo Purato: do not use.

entries.role: Giganos Captain, the only woman among Gon Jem's Four Kings; Stark Dyne pilot; later joins Meio
entries.personality: Fierce, violent and battle-hungry; later shows a devoted, gentler side toward Meio
entries.notes: Full name Lee Sue Min (リー・スー・ミン) per Mechapedia/en.wikipedia; official site English label "MIN". No dedicated wiki page. Variant: Lee Soo Min.

entries.role: Meio's younger sister; refugee who becomes an Earth Alliance communications operator; heroine
entries.personality: Gentle and reserved, opposes the war; slowly opens up to Kaine
entries.notes: Wiki and official site agree.

entries.role: Giganos hardliner; as Lieutenant Colonel he assassinates Marshal Guiltorre and becomes Supreme Leader of Giganos; pilots a black Gilgazamune at the end
entries.personality: Arrogant, power-hungry, cruel and treacherous; bullies subordinates; strong MA pilot but a poor commander
entries.notes: Dragonar wiki page title "Dorchenov" (also Mechapedia, villains wiki). en.wikipedia uses "Dolchenov" once in passing; the official site gives no English name. Variants: Dolchenov, Dorchenoff.

entries.role: Generic Giganos soldier/pilot (speaker label)
entries.notes: Built from the wiki faction name "Giganos".

entries.role: Generic Giganos officer (speaker label)
entries.notes: Built from the wiki faction name "Giganos".

entries.role: Formal name of the lunar state that declared independence from Earth
entries.notes: The wiki page title is just "Giganos" (body text: "Giganos Lunar Empire"). The full form varies: Unified Empire of Giganos (MAHQ; literal for 統一帝国), United Lunar Empire Giganos (en.wikipedia), United Empire Ghiganos (Sunrise international site). Use "Giganos" when space is tight. "Gigano Empire" is not attested anywhere; avoid.

entries.role: Common short name of the Unified Empire of Giganos
entries.notes: Dragonar wiki: "marshal of the Giganos Empire".

entries.role: Marshal and supreme leader of Giganos; assassinated by Dorchenov
entries.personality: Idealistic and honorable; loves Earth's beauty and restrains use of the Mass Driver
entries.notes: Official site: "GUILTORRE". The Dragonar wiki page title "Iskander Guiltorre" adds an unsourced first name (the ja novel gives "Messiah Guiltorre"). Use the title form without a first name, as the game does.

entries.role: Giganos fortress (ep. 21 title "ギガノス要塞破壊命令"; late in the series also the Giganos mobile space fortress)
entries.notes: No wiki page. Literal rendering. MAHQ/ja.wikipedia call the late-series one the "Mobile Space Fortress" (宇宙機動要塞). Check the in-game context to see which one is meant.

entries.role: The three D-series prototype Metal Armors (D-1, D-2, D-3), also called D-weapons
entries.notes: Wiki and official site agree.

entries.role: Humanoid combat mecha class of the series
entries.notes: Plural "Metal Armors"; abbreviation MA.

entries.role: Gon Jem's irregular unit, nicknamed the "Filth of Giganos"
entries.notes: Dragonar wiki/Mechapedia section heading "Gon Jem Squad". See the Gon Jem entry for the Gun/Gon question. Variants: Gon Jem Unit, Gon Jem Corps. His four officers are the "Gon Jem Four Kings" (Shitennou).

entries.role: FMA-04A Dyne, standard Giganos mass-production Metal Armor
entries.notes: CONTESTED. Dragonar wiki and Mechapedia: "FMA-04A Dyne". Official site: "DEINS"; MAHQ: "Dein"; SRW wiki list: "Deins". Wiki wins: Dyne.

entries.role: FMA-04G Stark Dyne, Min's custom Dyne with arm chainsaws
entries.notes: Follows Dyne. Variants: Stark Deins (Mechapedia character list), Stark Dein (MAHQ).

entries.role: XFMA-09 Falguen, Meio Plato's personal blue-purple Metal Armor
entries.notes: Wiki, official site ("FALGUEN") and MAHQ agree. Variant: Falgen (TCG). With flight unit: Falguen MAFFU.

entries.role: YFMA-08A Gelf, Dan Kruger's Metal Armor (Practice Squad)
entries.notes: All sources agree.

entries.role: YAMA-08B Jagd Gelf, Welner Fritz's artillery variant of the Gelf
entries.notes: Wiki and MAHQ: Jagd Gelf. The official site uses the label "GELF-B" (SRW wiki list too).

entries.role: YRMA-08C Reb Gelf, Karl Geiner's ECM variant of the Gelf
entries.notes: CONTESTED. Dragonar wiki/Mechapedia: "Reb Gelf" (once misspelled "Red Gelf"). MAHQ: "Revi Gelf". Official site: "GELF-C". Wiki wins: Reb Gelf; Revi Gelf is a reasonable alternative if the owner prefers MAHQ.

entries.role: YGMA-14 Gilgazamune, giant thought-controlled Metal Armor (Gon Jem's prototype; Heidelnecken and Dorchenov versions)
entries.notes: Wiki, MAHQ and en.wikipedia agree. Variant: Guilga Zamune (SRW wiki list).

entries.role: AMA-03B Gwei, widely used heavy Giganos mass-production Metal Armor
entries.notes: CONTESTED. Dragonar wiki/Mechapedia: "AMA-03B Gwei". Official site, MAHQ and SRW wiki: "Gewei". Wiki wins: Gwei, but Gewei has the stronger official backing. Owner decision suggested.

entries.role: ACE2 variant of the Gwei (the game also lists ゲバイ（ＳＰ） and ゲバイ・マッフ（ＳＰ）)
entries.notes: "SP" is an ACE2-only suffix with no wiki or series source; its meaning (special or space type) is unverified, so keep "SP" as written. Follows the Gwei/Gewei choice.

entries.role: AMA-03G Stark Gwei, Gol's custom Gwei
entries.notes: Follows Gwei. Variants: Stark Gewei (MAHQ, en.wikipedia), Star Gewei (SRW wiki typo).

entries.role: AFA-03 Dowtwen, Giganos atmospheric unit halfway between Metal Armor and Folg
entries.notes: CONTESTED. Dragonar wiki/Mechapedia: "Dowtwen". Official site, MAHQ and SRW wiki: "Dauzehn"; en.wikipedia: "Dauzhen". Wiki wins: Dowtwen, but it is a doubtful romanization of ダウツェン and Dauzehn has official backing. Owner decision suggested.

entries.ja: スターク・ダウツェン
entries.role: AFA-03G Stark Dowtwen, Zin's custom Dowtwen with hologram decoys
entries.notes: Follows Dowtwen. Variant: Stark Dauzehn (MAHQ, SRW wiki).

entries.ja: スターク・ガンドーラ
entries.role: Stark Gan Dolla, Ganan's custom Gan Dolla (splits into robot and motorcycle)
entries.notes: Wiki: "Stark Gan Dolla". MAHQ: "Stark Gan-Dolla" (official base unit "GAN-DOLLA"); SRW wiki: "Stark Gandolla". The difference is only hyphenation.

entries.role: Graia, Poseidal Army mass-production Heavy Metal
entries.notes: WRONG GROUP: not a Dragonar unit. In the game's lock-on list (work/translation/en/menu3061.json) it sits in the L-Gaim block (after オージ, before the Dragonar units), and MAHQ lists "Graia" and "Space Graia" among the L-Gaim Heavy Metals. No fandom wiki page found. Variant: Glaia. Should move to the L-Gaim group.

entries.role: Space-use variant of the Graia
entries.notes: WRONG GROUP: L-Gaim; see Graia.

entries.role: YAMA-13 Geyzam, Gon Jem's one-off prototype Metal Armor
entries.notes: Dragonar wiki/Mechapedia/en.wikipedia: "Geyzam". MAHQ and SRW wiki: "Geizam". Wiki wins: Geyzam.

entries.role: WAMA-07A Zuwai, Giganos amphibious close-combat Metal Armor
entries.notes: Wiki, official site ("ZUWAI") and MAHQ agree.

entries.role: XD-01 Dragonar-1 (Kaine), close-combat type
entries.notes: In-game short form of Dragonar-1. Use an ASCII hyphen.

entries.role: XD-01SR Dragonar-1 Custom (Kaine)
entries.notes: Official site label "D-1 CUSTOM".

entries.role: XD-02 Dragonar-2 (Tapp), long-range artillery type
XD-03 Dragonar-3 (Light), electronic warfare type

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: TV: cook and Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico, a Class-A Boson Jumper. PoD: the "Prince of Darkness", Black Sarena pilot hunting the Martian Successors
entries.personality: TV: kind, reluctant and insecure Gekiganger fan who wants to be a cook. PoD: cold, grim and vengeful after experiments destroyed his senses
entries.notes: Wiki title uses Western order; the game's ja uses Japanese order (family name Tenkawa first).

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Leader of the Nadesico's Aestivalis squad (red 0G frame)
entries.personality: Hot-headed, tough, brash tomboy; respects only people who prove themselves; secretly sweet on Akito
entries.notes: Wiki title; long vowel dropped (Ryouko).

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico (orange frame); a manga artist by PoD
entries.personality: Bubbly, energetic otaku and Gekiganger fan; teases Ryoko
entries.notes: Wiki title.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico (green frame); a bar musician by PoD
entries.personality: Gloomy, eerie, incurable punster; has a hidden serious side
entries.notes: Wiki title.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Officer of the Jovian Superior Jovian Male Forces (Yuujin Butai), Majin/Daimajin pilot; in PoD a Nergal operative who trained Akito
entries.personality: Proud, serious, intensely idealistic; haunted by having shot his friend Tsukumo
entries.notes: Wiki page title "Genichirou Tsukiomi". en.wikipedia character list: "Gen-Ichiro Tsukuomi". Variants: Genichiro Tsukiomi, Gen-ichiro Tsukiomi. Wiki wins.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Leader of the Martian Successors' assassin squad (Hokushin and his six men); Yatenkou pilot; kidnapped Akito and Yurika
entries.personality: Sadistic, cold, ruthless assassin; a master of both hand-to-hand and mecha combat
entries.notes: No Nadesico wiki page. "Hokushin" is the only romanization in use (en.wikipedia PoD article, BTVA, SRW fan sites). Single name.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Aestivalis pilot who is secretly the chairman of Nergal Heavy Industries
entries.personality: Flippant playboy; cynical, calculating businessman
entries.notes: Wiki title. The SRW wiki misspells it "Akatsuki Nagars".

entries.role: Original Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico (real name Jiro Yamada); killed early in the TV series
entries.personality: Loud, hot-blooded, obsessed with Gekiganger III; insists Gai is his soul's name
entries.notes: Wiki title; long vowel dropped (Daigouji). The SRW wiki misspells it "Daigodji".

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Captain of the ND-001 Nadesico; Akito's childhood friend and later wife; prisoner of the Martian Successors in PoD
entries.personality: Cheerful, airheaded and clingy toward Akito, but a genuinely brilliant tactician
entries.notes: Wiki title.

entries.ja: ミスマル・コウイチロウ
entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Admiral of the United Earth forces (Third Fleet); Yurika's father; senior UESF commander in PoD
entries.personality: Doting, emotional father; stern but decent commander
entries.notes: Wiki title "Kouichiro" (no final u). The in-game label ミスマル refers to him, not Yurika. Variant: Koichiro Misumaru.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: TV: operator/science officer of the Nadesico. PoD: Lieutenant Commander, captain of the Nadesico B ("Electronic Fairy")
entries.personality: Deadpan, cool, blunt child prodigy (catchphrase "bunch of fools"); slowly warms to the crew
entries.notes: Wiki title.

entries.ja: イネス・フレサンジュ
entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Nergal scientist aboard the Nadesico (Mars survivor); explains the technology
entries.personality: Brilliant, self-absorbed lecturer who loves giving "explanations"; secretly the grown-up Ai
entries.notes: Wiki title. Variant: Ines Fressange.

entries.role: Lieutenant Commander in the Jovian Superior Jovian Male Forces; Tetsujin/Daitetsujin pilot; seeks peace with Earth
entries.personality: Honest, upright and idealistic, naive around women; hot-blooded Gekiganger fan
entries.notes: The name the Nadesico wiki links to (page not yet created); same in the en.wikipedia character list.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Generic Jovian Federation soldier (speaker label)
entries.notes: Built from the wiki faction name.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Generic Jovian Federation officer (speaker label)
entries.notes: Built from the wiki faction name.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Combined speaker label for the two pilots speaking together
entries.notes: Plain ASCII ampersand.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Jupiter-based anti-Earth state, main enemy faction of the TV series (romaji Mokuren)
entries.notes: Wiki title; the wiki infobox gives kanji 木連, romaji Mokuren. Earth calls them the "Jovian Lizards". Avoid "Mokuren" in English text.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Corporation that built the Nadesico and the Aestivalis
entries.notes: Wiki title.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: ND-001 Nadesico, Nergal's battleship
entries.notes: Wiki title "ND-001 Nadesico". Italicize as a ship name if the style guide allows.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
entries.role: NS-955B Nadesico B, second-generation Nadesico-class battleship of the UESF captained by Ruri
entries.notes: Wiki title "NS-955B Nadesico B". Variant: Nadesico-B (en.wikipedia).

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Earth's unified space force after the war; operates the Nadesico B
entries.notes: No Nadesico wiki page of its own (the "United Confederation" page is empty), and the wiki names it inconsistently: "UESF (4th Fleet)", "United Earth Spacy", "USF Third Fleet". en.wikipedia PoD article: "UESF". Literal: United Space Force.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Teleportation/time-displacement technology of the setting
entries.notes: Wiki uses "Boson Jump" and "Boson Jumper"; verb form "Boson Jumping".

entries.role: Akito's Aestivalis (TV series)
entries.notes: Wiki spelling "Aestivalis". The SRW wiki's "Aestevalis" is a typo.

entries.role: Gai's Aestivalis (TV series)
Hijacked mass-production Aestivalis controlled by Jovian Batta (enemy unit)
entries.notes: No Nadesico wiki page. The SRW wiki describes it as "Devil Aestevalis"; spelling corrected to the wiki's Aestivalis.

entries.role: Jovian manned mecha (Tsukumo Shiratori)
entries.notes: Listed on the Nadesico wiki faction page.

entries.role: Jovian manned mecha (Genichirou Tsukiomi)
entries.notes: Listed on the Nadesico wiki faction page.

entries.role: Upgraded Jovian Tetsujin (Tsukumo; later Takasugi)
entries.notes: Listed on the Nadesico wiki faction page.

entries.role: Upgraded Jovian Majin (Tsukiomi)
entries.notes: Listed on the Nadesico wiki faction page.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Akito's armored, high-mobility custom Aestivalis in Prince of Darkness
entries.notes: Wiki title. Variant: Black Selena (SRW wiki).

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Akito's custom Aestivalis left when the Black Sarena purges its armor (listed right after Black Sarena in the game menus)
entries.notes: ACE2-only blend (Akito + Aestivalis) with no wiki or series source for the name. The SRW wiki calls this frame "Aestevalis Akito Custom"; ja.wikipedia: アキト用エステバリスカスタム. "Akitovalis" keeps the game's wordplay; "Aestivalis Akito Custom" is the safe alternative. Owner decision suggested.

entries.series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Motion Picture - Prince of Darkness
entries.role: Hokushin's personal mecha in Prince of Darkness (leads the Rokuren units)
entries.notes: No Nadesico wiki page. Romanizations: Yatenkou (common in SRW English material), Yatenko (a fan wiki, en.wikipedia). "Yatenkou" matches the wiki's long-vowel style (Kouichiro, Genichirou). The game also writes it ヤテンコウ in one menu.
